title: Above The Ramp
about: Facing a fear of heights while helping build the State Arts-In set.
description: This track recalls working high above a ramp on an awkwardly positioned ladder during State Arts-In. Every movement brought a reminder of the drop below, yet the work still needed to be finished. It's about discovering that courage isn't the absence of fear, but continuing forward despite it.
lyrics: The zigzag ramp below the side.
With the drop beneath our legs.
With my fear inside my hands.
We carried it above the ramp
And tried to make it sure.
Every shift of weight reminded me
How far there was to fall.
My only thought was, "Don't look down.
Just hold it to the wall."
With my fear inside my hands.
The crew kept moving under us.
No one stopped the whole production
For the fear I never showed.
Kept my focus on the frame,
When both feet touched ground again.
With my fear inside my hands.
Or every word that Jules and I said.
I remember climbing past the rail
And every warning in my head.
And courage felt less like a roar
I just did the job below it.
